rows.speaker: Torres
rows.en: Enemy forces incoming!
rows.display_text: 「Enemy forces incoming!」

rows.speaker: Bright
rows.en: All units, prepare to intercept!
rows.display_text: 「All units, prepare to intercept!」

rows.speaker: Matthieu
rows.en: Here they come! All the big names lined up together!
rows.display_text:
「Here they come! All the big names lined
up together!」

rows.speaker: Scirocco
rows.en: Kamille Bidan isn't here...? Not Char, not Amuro Ray either...?
rows.display_text:
「Kamille Bidan isn't here...? Not Char,
not Amuro Ray either...?」

rows.speaker: Alan
rows.en: You're telling me Roger Smith isn't here either...!?
rows.display_text:
「You're telling me Roger Smith isn't here
either...!?」

rows.speaker: Cynthia
rows.en: Ehh! King isn't even here either!
rows.display_text: 「Ehh! King isn't even here either!」

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: What?! Where's that lookalike of the END!?
rows.display_text:
「What?! Where's that lookalike of the
END!?」

rows.speaker: Scirocco
rows.en: Hmph... Sounds like this is going to be a dull fight.
rows.display_text:
「Hmph... Sounds like this is going to be
a dull fight.」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: Shut your mouth!
rows.display_text: 「Shut your mouth!」

rows.speaker: Sochie
rows.en: We're the ones who'll be taking you all on!
rows.display_text:
「We're the ones who'll be taking you all
on!」

rows.speaker: Birin
rows.en: Look away for a second and you'll get more than just hurt!
rows.display_text:
「Look away for a second and you'll get
more than just hurt!」

rows.speaker: Gavane
rows.en: We'll show you! The fighting spirit of the Suicide Squad!
rows.display_text:
「We'll show you! The fighting spirit of
the Suicide Squad!」

rows.speaker: Gauli
rows.en: Don't let your guard down, everyone! Burn with the spirit of Yapan!
rows.display_text:
「Don't let your guard down, everyone!
Burn with the spirit of Yapan!」

rows.speaker: Hidler
rows.en: Silence! If Getter Robo isn't here, that only works in our favor!
rows.display_text:
「Silence! If Getter Robo isn't here, that
only works in our favor!」

rows.speaker: Hola
rows.en: We'll crush you all and drag Jiron out of hiding!
rows.display_text:
「We'll crush you all and drag Jiron out
of hiding!」

rows.speaker: Blume
rows.en: You really think you lot can pull that off?
rows.display_text:
「You really think you lot can pull that
off?」

rows.speaker: Maai
rows.en: We'll make you regret ever underestimating us!
rows.display_text:
「We'll make you regret ever
underestimating us!」

rows.speaker: Sayaka
rows.en: Watch closely, Koji! Watch us fight!
rows.display_text: 「Watch closely, Koji! Watch us fight!」

rows.speaker: Bright
rows.en: All units, begin the attack! Target the enemy's ace pilots!
rows.display_text:
「All units, begin the attack! Target the
enemy's ace pilots!」

rows.speaker: Bright
rows.en: The operation time limit is 8 minutes! We settle this before then!
rows.display_text:
「The operation time limit is 8 minutes!
We settle this before then!」

rows.speaker: Torres
rows.en: Enemy force confirmed destroyed!
rows.display_text: 「Enemy force confirmed destroyed!」

rows.speaker: Bright
rows.en: Somehow, we pulled out a win...
rows.display_text: 「Somehow, we pulled out a win...」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: Of course we did, Captain. This is what we're really capable of.
rows.display_text:
「Of course we did, Captain. This is what
we're really capable of.」

rows.speaker: Katz
rows.en: We've come through some fierce battles ourselves, you know.
rows.display_text:
「We've come through some fierce battles
ourselves, you know.」

rows.speaker: Bright
rows.en: That's true. Well done, everyone. I salute your hard-fought efforts.
rows.display_text:
「That's true. Well done, everyone. I
salute your hard-fought efforts.」

rows.speaker: Hola
rows.en: Th-that's ridiculous! Losing to mere side characters!!
rows.display_text:
「Th-that's ridiculous! Losing to mere
side characters!!」

rows.speaker: Dike
rows.en: You never stop running your mouth, do you, right to the bitter end.
rows.display_text:
「You never stop running your mouth, do
you, right to the bitter end.」

rows.speaker: Blume
rows.en: If we're side characters, then you're the eternal loser of the show.
rows.display_text:
「If we're side characters, then you're
the eternal loser of the show.」

rows.speaker: Hidler
rows.en: Nuaaah! To fall before I even get to fight Getter Robo!
rows.display_text:
「Nuaaah! To fall before I even get to
fight Getter Robo!」

rows.speaker: Jun
rows.en: We're warriors fighting to protect peace too, you know.
rows.display_text:
「We're warriors fighting to protect
peace too, you know.」

rows.speaker: Maria
rows.en: We won't lose to some demon who only ever fights dirty!
rows.display_text:
「We won't lose to some demon who only
ever fights dirty!」

rows.speaker: Scirocco
rows.en: I, of all people...! Falling here, before I could even fulfill my role of guiding the world!
rows.display_text:
「I, of all people...! Falling here, before
I could even fulfill my role of guiding
the world!」

rows.speaker: Fa
rows.en: We did it...! We took down Paptimus Scirocco!
rows.display_text:
「We did it...! We took down Paptimus
Scirocco!」

rows.speaker: Apolly
rows.en: Differences in mobile suit performance aren't what decide the outcome of a fight... The same goes for having an ace pilot.
rows.display_text:
「Mobile suit performance differences
don't decide a fight's outcome... The same
goes for having an ace pilot.」

rows.speaker: Roberto
rows.en: If you think one pilot's skill decides the tide of a battle, you're dead wrong.
rows.display_text:
「If you think one pilot's skill decides
the tide of a battle, you're dead wrong.」

rows.speaker: Kashmir
rows.en: Th-this power exceeds my calculations...! It's thrown my whole schedule into chaos!!
rows.display_text:
「Th-this power exceeds my
calculations...! It's thrown my whole
schedule into chaos!!」

rows.speaker: Gauli
rows.en: For a man who's mastered Yapan Ninpo like me, your Overskill was wasted effort.
rows.display_text:
「For a man who's mastered Yapan Ninpo
like me, your Overskill was wasted effort.」

rows.speaker: Bello
rows.en: Did you see that, Gainer! We did it!!
rows.display_text: 「Did you see that, Gainer! We did it!!」

rows.speaker: Cynthia
rows.en: What is going on here!? I refuse to accept a game over in a place like this!
rows.display_text:
「What is going on here!? I refuse to
accept a game over in a place like this!」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: Teacher Adette doesn't lose to some kid who's still playing at war like it's a game.
rows.display_text:
「Teacher Adette doesn't lose to some
kid who's still playing at war like it's a
game.」

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: What?! What is this!? Why am I the one losing!?
rows.display_text:
「What?! What is this!? Why am I the one
losing!?」

rows.speaker: Matthieu
rows.en: Little lady... you sure you're not underestimating us?
rows.display_text:
「Little lady... you sure you're not
underestimating us?」

rows.speaker: Hilda
rows.en: We're Gekkostate too, you know. We're not fighting with half-hearted feelings.
rows.display_text:
「We're Gekkostate too, you know. We're
not fighting with half-hearted feelings.」

rows.speaker: Alan
rows.en: Wh-why, Big Duo!? Why do you reject me!?
rows.display_text:
「Wh-why, Big Duo!? Why do you reject
me!?」

rows.speaker: Joseph
rows.en: So this is the end for a man seduced by the power of a mechanical giant. How pitiful...
rows.display_text:
「So this is the end for a man seduced
by the power of a mechanical giant. How
pitiful...」

rows.speaker: Saegusa
rows.en: Captain! If we keep fighting like this, we'll only take heavier losses!
rows.display_text:
「Captain! If we keep fighting like this,
we'll only take heavier losses!」

rows.speaker: Bright
rows.en: One minute...! We settle this in the next one minute! If it's no good, we pull back!!
rows.display_text:
「One minute...! We settle this in the
next one minute! If it's no good, we pull
back!!」

rows.speaker: Torres
rows.en: T-the operation's 8-minute time limit has passed!
rows.display_text:
「T-the operation's 8-minute time limit
has passed!」

rows.speaker: Bright
rows.en: Damn... this force isn't enough! All units, fall back!!
rows.display_text:
「Damn... this force isn't enough! All
units, fall back!!」

rows.speaker: Bright
rows.en: Food poisoning!?
rows.display_text: 「Food poisoning!?」

rows.speaker: Torres
rows.en: Y-yes sir! Most of the pilots are unable to sortie!
rows.display_text:
「Y-yes sir! Most of the pilots are
unable to sortie!」

rows.speaker: Saegusa
rows.en: Enemy forces approaching our position! Radish reports it's a considerable force!
rows.display_text:
「Enemy forces approaching our position!
Radish reports it's a considerable force!」

rows.speaker: Saegusa
rows.en: Confirmed sightings: Gear Gear, Mecha Yosaiki, The O, Planeta, Dominator, the END, and Big Duo Inferno!
rows.display_text:
「Confirmed sightings: Gear Gear, Mecha
Yosaiki, The O, Planeta, Dominator, the
END, and Big Duo Inferno!」

rows.speaker: Bright
rows.en: This is unbelievable...
rows.display_text: 「This is unbelievable...」

rows.speaker: Torres
rows.en: What do we do, Captain!? Do we fall back!?
rows.display_text:
「What do we do, Captain!? Do we fall
back!?」

rows.speaker: Bright
rows.en: We've come too far to turn back now! We fight with whatever pilots we've got able to sortie!
rows.display_text:
「We've come too far to turn back now!
We fight with whatever pilots we've got
able to sortie!」

rows.speaker: Bright
rows.en: Anyone fit to fight, borrow a unit from a pilot with food poisoning and get out there!
rows.display_text:
「Anyone fit to fight, borrow a unit from
a pilot with food poisoning and get out
there!」
